children: , a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing innovative therapies for severe and difficult-to-treat diseases with significant unmet medical need, today announced that the company will participate in the following investor conferences:
12th Cantor Global Healthcare Conference in New York City Fireside chat: Friday, September 11, 2026, at 9:45 a.m. ET.
H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference in New York City 1x1 investor meetings: September 14-16, 2026
A live webcast of the Cantor fireside chat will be available
. A replay will be available for 90 days following the event.

is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing innovative therapies for severe and difficult-to-treat diseases with significant unmet medical need. SCY-770 is being developed for the treatment of Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease (ADPKD) and has been granted Orphan Drug designation. SCYNEXIS’s proprietary antifungal platform “fungerps” includes BREXAFEMME® (ibrexafungerp tablets), the first approved representative of this novel class, which has been licensed to GSK, and SCY-247, currently in clinical stages of development. For more information, visit www.scynexis.com

title: SCYNEXIS to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
